title: Yellow Noodle Stir Fry with Mitsuba
description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with yellow noodles, mitsuba, and a hint of Malaysian spices. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: 1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
2. Drain the noodles and set aside.
3. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
4. Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant.
5. Add the mitsuba and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until wilted.
6. Add the cooked noodles and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until combined with the vegetables.
7. In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and honey until smooth.
8. Pour the soy sauce mixture over the noodles and stir-fry until everything is well coated.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Serve immediately and garnish with additional mitsuba if desired.
